title: 3 Homes Together | Sleeps 30+ | 5 Miles to DT!
description:
Bring the whole crew! This rare Nashville find offers three full homes rented together, just 5 minutes from Broadway and the heart of Music City. Perfect for large groups, family reunions, bachelor/ette trips, or corporate retreats, these stylishly designed homes provide plenty of space for everyone to stay close—while still enjoying privacy.

Each home features modern kitchens, comfortable living areas, and multiple bedrooms/bathrooms to accommodate your group with ease. Outside, enjoy private

The space
Each Home Includes:

3 Bedrooms / 3 Bathrooms

5 Beds Total

1 King Bed

2 Queen Beds

2 Additional Queen Beds

Modern, fully stocked kitchen

Open-concept living + dining area

Rooftop deck or private patio for relaxing & gathering

Total Across All 3 Homes:

9 Bedrooms / 9 Bathrooms

15 Beds (3 Kings + 12 Queens)

Comfortably sleeps 30+ guests

With multiple living spaces, plenty of bathrooms, and private rooftops/patios, your group will have the perfect balance of togetherness and comfort.

Guest access
Guests will have full access to all three homes during their stay. Each property is equipped with a Yale smart lock—you’ll receive a personalized entry code in your check-in instructions prior to arrival. No keys to keep track of, and easy self check-in any time after 4 PM.

Other things to note
We’d love to host you, whether you’re visiting for a single night, a month, or even up to six months. At BetterBNB, our mission is to provide a clean, comfortable, and welcoming home where every guest feels cared for.

Your safety and comfort are our top priorities. We take pride in creating a space where you can relax, recharge, and feel at ease during your time in Nashville. Thank you for trusting us with your stay—we look forward to making your experience smooth, stress-free, and memorable.
